data.name: aiReportPrompt2.Text
data.value:
Create Sales Summary Report
**Page Setup**:
* Paper size: A4 * Margins: * Top & Bottom: 40 * Left & Right: 60
* All controls should fit within printable width * Report control paddings * Left: 2 * Top: 2 **Font Settings**:
* Page Header: Segoe UI, 18pt, Bold * Table Column Headers: Segoe UI, 10pt, Bold, White * Data Table Cells: Segoe UI, 9pt * Summary Cells: Arial, 9pt, Bold, Light Gray
**Report Sections**:
* Page Header:
* Add the title “Quarterly Sales Report” with a dark gray background and white text. * Center-align and span full page width.
* Group Header:
* Group data by Region * Add a table with a light gray background and the following columns: * Region * Sales Rep * Product * Units Sold * Total Sales ($)
* Details Section:
* Bind fields from data source to above columns.
* Group Footer:
* Add totals per Region: * Total Units Sold — Summary * Regional Sales Total — Summary * Average Sale per Unit — Average
* Page Footer:
* Add Report Generated Date and Page Number (centered).

data.name: aiReportPrompt3.Text
data.value:
Create Employee Payroll Report:
Page Setup:
- Paper size: Letter - Margins: - Top & Bottom: 50 - Left & Right: 100 - Report controls should fit within the available page width (excluding left and right margins). - Font Settings: - Report Title: Arial, 16pt, Bold - Column Headers: Arial, 11pt, Bold - Data-bound controls: Arial, 9pt
Report Sections:
Page Header:
- Add a report title ""Payroll Details"" with a light blue background. Stretch it to fit the full page width.
Group Header:
- Create a group header containing a table with the following columns: - Employee Name - Department - Hours Worked - Rate ($) - Gross Salary ($)
Detail Table:
- Include a detail table with the same data-bound fields as in the group header.
Group Footer:
- Add a table with a light blue background containing the following columns: - Total Employees - Total Payroll Expense - Average Salary Include a data-bound table with calculations: - Total Employees: Count of Employee Names. - Total Payroll Expense: Sum of Gross Salary. - Average Salary: Average of Gross Salary.
Page Footer:
- Add a table with four columns: - Contact Us - Website Address - Phone - Email"

data.name: aiReportPrompt4.Text
data.value:
Create a Commercial Invoice Report
Page Setup:
- Paper Size: Letter - Margins: - Top & Bottom: 100 - Left & Right: 50 - Report controls should fit within the available page width (excluding left and right margins).
Font Settings: - Static text labels and column headers: - Background: Light grey - Text Color: White - Font: Arial, 10pt, Bold, Uppercase - Text Alignment: Top left - Data-bound report controls: - Font: Arial, 9pt - Text Color: Black - Text Alignment: Middle left
Report Sections:
Report Header:
- Add a logo/image aligned to the right, sized 200x50. - Include a full-width label with the static text ""Commercial Invoice"".
Group Header:
Create a 4-column table with the following column headers: - Shipper/Exporter of Record - (Empty Column for Spacing) - Shipment/Order - (Empty Column for Spacing)
Add the following rows under each respective column: - Shipper/Exporter of Record | (empty) | Shipment/Order | (empty) - Company Name | (empty) | Invoice # | (data-bound field) - Address | (empty) | Date | (data-bound field) - VAT Reg No | (empty) | Order ID | (data-bound field) - Shipper Address | (empty) | Number of Parcels | (data-bound field) - (empty) | (empty) | Total Actual Weight: | (data-bound field) - (empty) | (empty) | Total Dimensional Weight: | (data-bound field)
Create a 2-column table with the following column headers: - Ship To/Consignee - Sold To Party - Add a single row displaying the corresponding data-bound fields.
Create a table with the following column headers: - Description - Item Code - Country of Origin - Units - Unit Value - Total Value
Detail Table:
- Include a detail table displaying the same data-bound fields as in the Itemized Table from the Group Header.
Report Footer:
Create a 2-column table, aligned to the right and occupying half of the page width. - First Row: - Column 1: ""Total"" (Header) - Column 2: (Empty Cell) - Second Row: - Column 1: ""Goods Value"" - Column 2: (Data-bound to ""Total"" field)
- Add a label with the text ""Value For Customs"". - Add a data-bound label linked to the ""Value For Customs"" field.

data.name: aiReportPrompt5.Text
data.value:
Create a Shipping Label Report
Page Setup:
- Paper Size: Letter - Margins: - Top & Bottom: 50 - Left & Right: 100 - Report controls should fit within the available page width (excluding left and right margins). - Font settings: - Static text labels and column headers: light grey background, Arial 10pt font, bold - Data-bound report controls: Arial 9pt font
Report Sections:
Report Header:
- Company Name Report Title: Display in the top-middle of the page. Add smaller text aligned to the right side, stating ""Thank you for your order."" - Add Shipping Information Labels: - ""Ship To"" label on the left side, above the company name. Below it, add two more labels to display the customer name and the address. - ""Shipment Information"" label on the right side. Below it, add two more labels to display the order number and the date.
Group Header:
- Create a table with the following column headers: - # (Item Number) - Item - Color - Size - EAN - Quantity - Unit Price
Detail Table:
- Include a detail table displaying the same data-bound fields as in the group header.
Report Footer:
- Add a ""Returns Policy"" label. Below it, include an empty label for future content. - Add a ""Returns Instructions"" label. Below it, include another empty label for additional details.
